description: Invoice payment terms calculator — Turn invoice payment terms into exact dates and money: Net 30, 2/10 Net 30, 1/15 Net 45, Net 30 EOM, 10 EOM, 1/10 prox, 15 MFI, Due on receipt. Returns the due date (rolled off weekends and US federal holidays; adjust=next|previous|none), the last day to take an early-payment discount, discount amount and net payable (amount=), the annualized cost of skipping the discount, status as of a date (DISCOUNT_AVAILABLE / OPEN / DUE_TODAY / OVERDUE) with days and business days left. Optional as_of=YYYY-MM-DD (default today). Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_net_terms
